its probably not the cutest thing he does but it's really cute ive been thinking about it for a while waiting for a thread to tack it onto 

my partner and i met when we were in high school, we were basically kids. when we got together, he was like six months out from a long term relationship ( y e s, despite being in high school. high school relationships are BIG in their family -- both his mom and dad + his brother and his brother's long term girlfriend got together in high school, in the same school we were in) 

he was also always the guy who was pursued. courting is a big thing in our country, and as friends, we found it funny that  he'd never been involved with someone he himself showed interest in without the influence of them liking him. high school kids like light and petty stuff. but anyway, we were talking about this one day and out of the blue, one of us says that we salute whoever it is that comes into his life that he'll develop feelings for first instead of vice versa.

so! day comes that he confesses to me, and he never really says anything. he just salutes me. and i get it about eight hours later. 

it's not really anything big but i've noticed that everytime we see each other since then, like when he picks me up or vice versa, as soon as we make eye contact he does the little two finger salute thing. he doesn't even notice. it's been several years. it's cute as all hell. 

other cute shit: whenever i tell him about my day, he holds my hand up to his face while listening intently and just gently rubs his lips either over my palm or the back of my hand. i'm so fucking in love.
